title: Companies (Management and Administration) Rules, 2014 — Rule 17, requisitionists’ EGM

content.publisher: The Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI), e-book statutory text reproduction
content.citation: Companies (Management and Administration) Rules, 2014, rule 17; includes the 2016 substitution of “on any day except national holiday” for “on working day” in rule 17(2) Explanation
content.note: Professional-institute reproduction of rule text and amendment note, not a Gazette-primary source. Rule 17 text indicates clear 21 days’ advance requisitionists’ notice; meeting at the registered office or in the same city/town and not on a national holiday; notice contents/signature and delivery; no section 102 explanatory statement required for an EGM convened by requisitionists; member notice and member-list procedure. Obtain/verify the current official Gazette text before treating this as final statutory verification.
